verdict.rationale: Basecamp's evidence shows it can host or serve external AI agents: you can invite AI agents to projects, and it offers MCP support, a CLI and skills for agents you run on your own computer. None of these is an in-product facility for building and configuring your own custom agent. They are integration building blocks for agents built elsewhere, which are adjacent and earn no credit, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product
